steps.en: Officer confirms and the screen sends the stage change
steps.id: Officer konfirmasi dan layar mengirim perubahan stage

steps.en: Each notice is checked before the change is saved
steps.id: Tiap notice dicek dulu sebelum perubahan disimpan

steps.en: Notice moves to the new stage, backward or forward
steps.id: Notice pindah ke stage baru, mundur atau maju

steps.en: Amounts, flags and history are updated to match
steps.id: Jumlah, flag, dan riwayat ikut diperbarui

steps.en: Notice continues automatically from the new stage
steps.id: Notice lanjut diproses otomatis dari stage baru
steps.why_en: The stage values are set, but the letter run is manual and one follow-up job is switched off.
steps.why_id: Nilai stage sudah diisi, tetapi pembuatan surat dijalankan manual dan satu job lanjutan dimatikan.
